title: Meeting host
passage: You are leading the client meeting, are you not? A. The meeting room seats twelve. B. They are our largest client. C. Actually, Elena will be taking my place.
passageZh:
客戶會議是由你主持，對吧？
A. 會議室可坐十二人。
B. 他們是我們最大的客戶。
C. 其實 Elena 會代替我。
audioScript: You are leading the client meeting, are you not? A. The meeting room seats twelve. B. They are our largest client. C. Actually, Elena will be taking my place.
